title: Top-level array of two homogeneous objects
rationale: The single array shape the reconstructor was actually built for, and the only one that round-trips. It anchors every array DEFECT: without it a reviewer could conclude arrays are simply unsupported rather than that array support is present and mis-fires on every shape except this one.
catchesBugClass: Column-to-row transposition errors: mis-zipping fields, dropping the second element, losing the numeric type of 30/25, or reordering fields inside the element.
cannotCatch: The size-1 ambiguity (parsed.size() > 1 is the detection threshold and 2 clears it), the ragged/absent-field problem, and any nesting problem.

predicted.detail: Flattens to users_name = "[\"Alice\",\"Bob\"]" and users_age = "[30,25]". Prefix users sees two serialized values of parsed size 2, is flagged as an array, and reconstructArray zips the columns back into two elements.
